title: Trial Lesson to Calendar - Student Context - Single Student Trial Lesson - Student Pre-Selected on Calendar
description: AC 01.3 - Decision Table - Student from Trial Lesson is auto-selected when calendar opens via Lesson Calendar button.
preconditions:
- Actor is logged in to Salesforce as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-2001 has linked student STU-010 (name: Aki Tanaka).
- TL-2001 detail page is open before test.
steps_actions:
1. Click Lesson Calendar button on Trial Lesson TL-2001 detail page.
2. Open student selection/filter panel on Lesson Calendar.
3. Inspect selected student chip/row and compare with trial lesson student info.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Calendar page loads from Trial Lesson context.
2. Student STU-010 is already selected in panel context.
3. Selected student matches Aki Tanaka (STU-010).

1. trial_lesson = TL-2001
2. expected_student_id = STU-010
3. expected_student_name = Aki Tanaka
